inspiration: Title-screen ember fire (src/client/TitleFlames.ts): each frame seeds random hot pixels in the bottom rows (updateFlames), then every cell takes the average of its four neighbours (line 162). A cooling map value, at one fifth of its size, is subtracted from each cell (line 175). The cooling map is regenerated from a randomly picked rune sprite each time its cycle wraps (line 169). The look is a burn-through logo. Frankendom use: a title or pit-entrance ember with our own sigil as the burn-through pattern.
Palette ramp for the fire is built from four 64-step bands, from dark through red and yellow to white (for example line 53). A 256-entry table is cheap and reads as heat at a glance.

Breathing palette: two alternative palettes are cross-faded with counters that count down by four per update, and a new pulse starts only when both counters are zero, with a random draw each update that starts one palette on two of 2000 values (src/client/TitleFlames.ts lines 194 and 195, doBlend). Use for rune glow or zone light.
Wind as three summed sines, one term per frequency, feeding the top line of the fire (line 184). A cheap sway for banners, capes or flames.

Touch keyboard press feedback: a canvas keyboard with four modes (Regular, Shift, Symbols, SymbolsExtra, src/client/MobileKeyboard.ts line 59) and a timed press box (animateBoxIndex and animateBoxTimeout, lines 174 and 175). Relevant to touch UX (hud-ui fold-in): a press flash that expires on its own.

Animation transitions as named policies (src/config/SeqType.ts lines 6 to 16): PreanimMove (DELAYMOVE, DELAYANIM, MERGE), PostanimMove (DELAYMOVE, ABORTANIM, MERGE), RestartMode (RESET, RESETLOOP). Each animation-to-move hand-off has a stated rule. Relevant to parity rows 6 and 7 (strike wind-up and recovery).

Zoomable world map (src/mapview/MapView.ts): zoom defaults to 4 (line 126), the view is centred on a focus point and divided by the zoom, and an overview box with border colours sits in the corner. Relevant to the minimap and world map fold-in.

briefs.label: Ember title fire (burn-through seal)
briefs.why: Four-neighbour diffusion with a cooling map reads as heat at title size and needs no art beyond one seal.
briefs.keep: four-neighbour averaging; a cooling map drawn from a sprite; a 256-entry black-red-yellow-white ramp
briefs.change: our burn-through pattern is our own sigil; the ramp is cold blue to white; a slider for ember rate

briefs.label: Breathing rune glow
briefs.why: A rare palette pulse makes an idle screen feel alive without motion cost.
briefs.keep: two palettes cross-faded by counters; a rare random trigger
briefs.change: our hue pair; a slow sine in place of the counters; the pulse drives a rune, not the fire

briefs.label: Strike wind-up and recovery policy
briefs.why: Named rules for how an animation hands off to a move make attacks feel deliberate, with no combat-genre copy needed.
briefs.keep: the three-way choice per transition: delay the move, delay the animation, or merge; an abort option
briefs.change: our names and our own choice list, for example cancel on hit or cancel on dodge

briefs.label: Press flash on touch controls
briefs.why: A timed press flash on each touch control confirms the input without a text label.
briefs.keep: a timed press box that expires on its own; modes switch the layout
briefs.change: our attack-button layout and thumb reach; a ring flash instead of a box; no keyboard copy

briefs.label: Zoomable map with overview box
briefs.why: A zoom with a corner overview gives orientation at a glance on a phone.
briefs.keep: zoom as a number with a sensible default; the overview box in a corner
briefs.change: our map style and pins; the default zoom set for our zone size
